label_geometry_ceiling.finding: SDRP heuristic argmax on wrap=1 graphs yields majority class SDRP_NEIGHBORHOOD (id=4) at ~84.8–95.7% per structure (pooled 92.5%). Classes SDRP_SALT/HYDROPHOBE (2/3) have zero winners on these 12 folds despite R3/R4 edges existing — argmax loses to R5-dominated counts. This is by construction of sdrp_heuristic_from_edges + R5-heavy graphs, not a fold sampling accident.
label_geometry_ceiling.G_fit_train_min_bar_1_10: reachable on only 2/12 structures even at perfect accuracy
label_geometry_ceiling.implication: Locked-card INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT stands (bars not moved post-hoc). Scientific inference must not treat the 1.30 miss as architecture incapacity — the bar was an Arm-B-shaped lift threshold reused on a majority rate where max possible lift ≈ 1.04–1.18. Future capacity cards need a less majority-dominated target and/or a metric whose bars are reachable (e.g. macro-F1, balanced acc, or lift bars set below theoretical max).
